title: Coprime power maps on finite matrix groups are bijective
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $r\geq0$, and let $G$ be a finite subgroup of the group of invertible $r\times r$ matrices over $R$ [def-weil-matrix], with multiplication given by matrix multiplication and identity $I_r$. Invertible means admitting a two-sided matrix inverse. Let $n\geq0$ be an integer such that $\gcd(|G|,n)=1$. Then the map $G\to G$, $g\mapsto g^n$, is a bijection.

source.place: Nat.Coprime.pow_left_bijective, lines 1245-1247; direct specialization to the group G (the bijection is a bijection of sets, with no claim of multiplicativity).
